blocks.text: Condo buildings in Port Moody Centre
The Grande by Onni — 300 Morrissey Road (units also addressed 305 and 308 Morrissey Road), Suter Brook Village

A 26-storey tower by the Onni Group: the developer describes 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom homes with about 40,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenities as the final offering in Suter Brook Village; project reporting records 220 homes in the 26-storey tower. Current listings record units built 2022, Apartment/Condo form, in the Port Moody Centre sub-area. No source checked states any age restriction or rental restriction (any rental-restriction line would be void in any event —). Basis: developer source plus project reporting plus name-verifying current listings. Counted: 1.
Boardwalk at Klahanie (Polygon) — 600 Klahanie Drive and 700 Klahanie Drive

One wood-frame development across two addresses in Polygon's Klahanie masterplan, with residents' access to the Canoe Club amenity facility. The building directory records 700 Klahanie built in 2007 and 600 Klahanie built in 2008, a 150-unit development at the 700 address per a directory listing header, and bylaws of "pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions" — the rental-restriction element of that line is VOID since November 24, 2022. No source states any age restriction. Basis: building-directory entries for both addresses plus name-verifying current listings. Counted: 1 (one development, two addresses).
50 Electronic (50 Electronic Avenue) — 55 Klahanie Drive

A six-storey strata condo building across from Rocky Point Park: current listings record Apartment/Condo units under the subdivision name "50 Electronic Avenue," built 2023, with the Club 50 amenity set (fitness centre, yoga studio, media room, cowork lounge, guest suite, dog wash, children's play area and garden plots) and a listing line of a maximum of 2 pets. Unit count: Not confirmed from the sources checked. Counted: 1.
Platform by Aragon — 83 Moody Street

An industrial-inspired strata development at Moody and Clarke by Aragon Properties, whose own communities page lists Platform as its Port Moody project. Build year is not confirmed between sources: the directory records Platform built in 2019, while current listings consistently record 2021 for its Apartment/Condo units (subdivision name "Platform By Aragon," Freehold Strata) — quote neither year until the strata plan settles it. The directory records its bylaws as "pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed" (no rental restriction stated). The development also contains townhouse-form units at the same address (see below) — counted once, as one development. No age restriction is stated in any source. Counted: 1.
Streets, schools and getting around Port Moody Centre

items.t: Where condo stock concentrates: around the two stations — Suter Brook Village and Newport Village by Inlet Centre Station, Klahanie along Klahanie Drive, and the St. Johns Street / Moody Street shelf by Moody Centre Station. The detached stock on the Moody Centre side streets is among the city's oldest.

Schools and catchments: SD43 catchments are address-based and do not follow neighbourhood lines — a locator run for 100 Newport Drive returned Mountain Meadows Elementary, Scott Creek Middle and Gleneagle Secondary, while Moody Elementary, Moody Middle and Port Moody Secondary (300 Albert Street) are the central schools. Check the exact address in the locator before relying on a school name.

Parks, recreation and civic: Rocky Point Park (pier, boat launch, outdoor pool, skate park, playground; start of the Shoreline Trail); Port Moody Recreation Complex, 300 Ioco Road; Kyle Centre, 125 Kyle Street; Port Moody Public Library, 100 Newport Drive. Eagle Ridge Hospital is in Port Moody at 475 Guildford Way, just east of the centre.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Port Moody Centre

items.t: Port Moody property taxes and utilities: 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; utilities (water, sewer, waste) are billed separately, with the 2026 utility bill due February 27, 2026 — budget both bills, not just the tax notice.

blocks.text: Good to know about Port Moody Centre

items.t: Port Moody replaced its OCP this year, and the old number is everywhere. OCP Bylaw 2026, No. 3522 was adopted April 28, 2026 and repeals Bylaw No. 2955; listing packages and older guides still cite 2955. Any OCP argument for a Port Moody Centre purchase should run off 3522 — and "Port Moody Centre" itself is a board name, not an OCP neighbourhood (the plan says Moody Centre and Inlet Centre).

One Noons Creek Drive address holds three different seniors services. 101 Noons Creek Drive is simultaneously the Housing Registry seniors residence (directory name "Inlet Centre"; residence name Alex Graham Manor), the 10-bed Crossroads hospice, and The Club, the 50+ drop-in café run out of the residence's former dining room. A buyer reading only one source will mislabel the building.
The attached median fell while the detached median held. SnapStats GVR September 2026 report.
A verified building can still be unverifiable. Listing consistency is not verification.
The small-lot map is drawn by neighbourhood, and this sub-area is on the right side of it.

Heritage rules touch the cheapest detached stock, not the condos. The older houses around St. Johns, Clarke and Murray Streets sit in the Moody Centre heritage conservation area, where a heritage alteration permit can be required for construction or reconstruction — a cost and timeline item that never appears in listing text.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Port Moody Centre
Streets, schools and getting around Port Moody Centre

items.t: Port Moody Centre is the board (GVR) sub-area for the city's downtown/station core at the head of the Port Moody Arm of Burrard Inlet, around St. Johns, Clarke and Murray Streets, between Moody Centre Station and Rocky Point Park, taking in Newport and Suter Brook villages by Inlet Centre Station. Exact board boundary roads: Not verified.

Transit/roads: Moody Centre Station (Millennium Line Evergreen Extension, West Coast Express, bus loop) and Inlet Centre Station east; St. Johns and Clarke are the main east–west roads, Barnet Highway west to Burnaby.

Schools: SD43, address-based. Completed locator run documented in this area's own research (2026-10-23) for 100 Newport Drive returned Mountain Meadows Elementary, Scott Creek Middle and Gleneagle Secondary — not the central schools (Moody Elementary, Ecole Moody Middle, Port Moody Secondary, 300 Albert St) a buyer would assume. Other addresses: Not verified.

Parks/civic/health: Rocky Point Park (pier, boat launch, pool, skate park; Shoreline Trail start); Recreation Complex 300 Ioco Road; Kyle Centre 125 Kyle St; Library 100 Newport Dr; Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, just east.
Heritage: Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area — a heritage alteration permit can be required for construction/reconstruction on included (older detached) properties.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Port Moody Centre

items.t: Form B diligence (every strata, incl. Platform/Boardwalk): SPA s.59 — fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; rules, budget, Rental Disclosure Statement and most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page. At Platform the Form B/strata plan is also where the 2019 vs 2021 build-year conflict is settled.

Rental-restriction bylaws VOID: since Nov 24, 2022 — flagged in-entry: Boardwalk's directory restriction element is VOID for long-term rentals; short-term rentals can still be restricted. Port Moody STR position: Not verified.

City plan/zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2018, No. 2937: RS detached, RT/RM multi-residential, TC/CRM mixed-use; transit-oriented areas are exempt from SSMUH; RS1-S small lots (min 9 m / 325 m²) available in Moody Centre OCP Single Family–Low Density areas.
Property taxes/utilities: 2026 taxes due July 2, 2026 (5% after July 2, further 5% after Sept 15); utilities billed separately, 2026 utility bill due Feb 27, 2026.

Taxes/rebates/financing: PTT 1% / 2% / 3% tiers plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3M — any "Over $3M — 5%" line compresses 3% + 2% and is flagged. Exemptions: first-time buyers full on first $500,000 at ≤$835,000, partial to $860,000; newly built full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000. Example (input: $715,000 community attached median, no exemption): $12,300. FTHB GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 — never March 12): 100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, max $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; New Housing Rebate 36%, max $6,300, $350K–$450K phase-out; HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. GST on new construction (incl. Inlet District / Westport presales), not resales. Vancouver EHT does NOT apply.

blocks.text: Good to know about Port Moody Centre

items.t: Port Moody replaced its OCP in 2026 — Bylaw 2026, No. 3522 (Apr 28, 2026) repeals No. 2955; packages still citing 2955 are out of date, and "Port Moody Centre" itself is a board name (the plan says Moody Centre + Inlet Centre).

A verified building can still have an unverifiable year. Platform is verified by its developer, yet its build year is 2019 in the directory and 2021 in listings — verification of existence is not verification of every detail.
Sonrisa trades openly and is still not verified — consistent listings across brokerages, but no developer/strata/manager/City source in repeated passes. Listing consistency is not verification.
The Newport Drive catchment crosses into Coquitlam — 100 Newport Dr locates to Gleneagle Secondary in Coquitlam, per the documented SD43 run.
Utilities are a second City bill — water/sewer/waste billed separately from taxes (2026 utility bill due Feb 27), on top of strata fees.

The small-lot map favours this side of the city — RS1-S is available in Moody Centre (and Seaview/Pleasantside) but not College Park, so identical detached lots carry different split potential by sub-area.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $705,000 (the middle half sold between $602,000 and $797,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $809 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $459 a month. 31 townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $1,112,000 (the middle half sold between $954,500 and $1,181,750), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $784 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $430 a month.
